WHEN TO CALL

TIRE CHANGES
STARTS WITH A CALL.

A flat tire and a vehicle equipped with a suitable, usable spare.

WHAT TO EXPECT

Tell Dave your location, vehicle type, whether you have a spare, and whether a wheel-lock key is required. Confirm that the location allows safe service.

BEFORE SERVICE

Confirm the quote and current availability directly with Dave. Mention any vehicle damage or access restrictions.

Do I need a spare tire?+

This service is described for vehicles with a usable spare. Tell Dave if you do not have one to discuss next steps.
